tof.distance: slant range along a normalized spherical-angle ray
tof.close_range_semantics: Below 0.1 m is TooClose/unreliable, never a valid free-space observation
tof.close_range_model: Conservative course slant-range filter; official kinematics also filters near points. This does not reproduce the chip's target-status firmware

head_imu.simulation_model: biased/noisy local gyro and specific force; lightweight complementary tilt fusion
head_imu.orientation_reference: gravity-aligned local frame, yaw initialized at zero and integrated from gyro
